note: RAID2 (owner 2026-09-02, HF-408). Additive family, same reason as pass77, pass79 and pass84: the Pass 66 masters choreography is digest-pinned by the retained production gate, so a new arena rides beside it rather than rewriting accepted history. This is the AUTHORING recipe. The orbit is fitted to RAID2_BOUNDS (100 x 76 m, the same box the shipped Raid uses) rather than copied from another arena: radius 48 x 38 is the half-extent of that box, and the 30 m altitude clears the map's tallest authored mass (the 5.3 m upper wall) by the same margin Map 3's 34 m clears its 5.2 m gantries. The phase is set so the pass opens over the pool terrace - the map's one 52 m lane and the whole point of the rebuild - rather than over a spawn apron.
